name: Family at Home 2
source:
Family at Home 2 takes you to the perspective of a successful adult who lives happily with his two daughters and his loving wife, until the unexpected arrival of a peculiar new family neighbor.
This event will trigger a series of problems and unearth secrets from your past that should not be discovered.
What starts out as a tale of glamorous life, but it will eventually be filled with darkness, forged from dark money, betrayal, jealousy, sex, and even murder. All this conflict is seen from your perspective.

[From Itch.io]
translation:
在《Family at Home 2》中，你将扮演一位事业有成的成年人，原本与两个女儿和深爱自己的妻子过着幸福美满的生活，直到一户怪异的新邻居意外搬来。
这一事件将引发一连串的麻烦，并挖出你过去那些绝不该被人知晓的秘密。
故事起初看似是一段光鲜亮丽的生活写照，最终却被黑金、背叛、嫉妒、性爱乃至谋杀所交织出的黑暗彻底吞噬。而这一切冲突，都将通过你的视角一一呈现。

[引自Itch.io]
